about: Pro Tools internal command names (the "Command" field of .ptpreset / PTCustomHotkeys.txt) for each Slur row, in menu-commands.json order. ids: commands whose bindings give the row its key (first non-focus binding of the first id that has one); focusIds: extra commands that only lend their Commands-Focus key; filter: "shift" = only the bindings that include ⇧ (the extend form of a navigation command), "noshift" = only those without. Rows whose Pro Tools command already belongs to another row are left empty so an import gives no duplicate keys. Use with protools-decode.mjs: ptRowKeys(ptApply(defaults, userFile).table, row).

storage.quickPresets: ~/Documents/Pro Tools/Pro Tools Presets/Keyboard Shortcuts/Quick Preset 1.ptpreset … Quick Preset 5.ptpreset
storage.namedPresets: ~/Documents/Pro Tools/Pro Tools Presets/Keyboard Shortcuts/*.ptpreset (Application/ = Avid's alternate-DAW presets)
